summary: The registrant, Gabelli Global Utility & Income Trust, filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose the hospitalization of Mario J. Gabelli, its Chairman and Chief Investment Officer, who is recovering from a medical incident. The fund's adviser, Gabelli Funds LLC, has implemented a long-standing succession plan, with Christopher J. Marangi as President of the parent company GAMCO, and Kevin V. Dreyer and Marangi co-leading portfolio management. This is a disclosure of a management succession plan, not a special situation; no transaction or corporate action is involved.
